scope: Direct universal-uniqueness attempt; preserve all prior C30/F22 contributions and unrelated edits.

shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **普遍唯一性推进到明确障碍 / Universal uniqueness tested to a substantive wall, 8 October 2026.** [本轮整合](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-UNIVERSALITY-INTEGRATION.md)新增61项 Lean 定理／135项含继承审计（123空、12继承propext）：任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案、最少状态及最少边仍不保证机制唯一；确定、可达且后续可区分的系统则有唯一结构对应。既有具体规律／对应推导保留信用。 / All 61 new audits are empty. The wall is the independent warrant of a universally separating explanandum, not an unfinished local proof; the global conjecture remains open, and the false minimal-mechanism strengthening is retained.

**普遍唯一性的实际障碍 / Universal-uniqueness boundary, 8 October 2026.** [最新检验](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#42-直接尝试普遍唯一性)新增61项实查定理：得到任意关系恢复判准、真正最小而不同构的生成机制，以及确定性范围内唯一对应。 / Complete existential success answers and state/edge minimality do not identify one mechanism. Concrete effective-law/correspondence results retain credit; a universal adequacy argument remains missing.

**Universal-uniqueness test, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s exact instruction](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-explanatory-necessity.md#推进到实际障碍--push-until-a-wall) requests exploration until a substantive wall. [Primary-source comparison](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-UNIVERSALITY-INTEGRATION.md#8-primary-source-assessment-and-genealogy) reads Brzozowski–Tamm’s distinctions between trimness, reduction, minimum states and deterministic canonical form. Link-only source assessment; 61 checked repository theorems, no mathematical novelty or independent-agent claim.

**Universal structural uniqueness tested to its present wall, 8 October 2026.** [The 61-theorem study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-UNIVERSALITY-INTEGRATION.md) proves arbitrary-relation descent iff answer saturation, a minimal-state/minimal-edge nonisomorphism counterexample, and uniqueness for rooted deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations. The new audits are all empty; the 135-audit closure has 123 empty and 12 inherited propext lists. Collective predictions can coincide while native mechanisms differ; all-predicate recovery retains all supplied distinctions without selecting an ontology. Existing concrete law and correspondence derivations remain established. The unresolved universal inference is why every adequate explanandum must separate the requisite native relations; neither the general conjecture nor G0 is refuted by the scoped counterexample.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 独立指定的取得、错误与后续问题要求保留实际差异和共同边界；接合探针进一步恢复有限片段接口，三元关系唯一确定局部单位，完整有限轨迹恢复其状态接口。整体表述仍合格，容量反例限定接口匹配的充分性。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。
C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise.
C30.scope_zh: 此前各轮及实际展开42项定理／64项新审计保留原范围与独立评审；本轮另54项（23＋31）／128项含继承审计：105空、23仅propext。探针可用性、状态内容及完整接续条件明示；共享容量／并行冲突下的定义域与输出识别仍待推进。 新增14项定理／18项空依赖审计，另192项继承依赖不变（150空、42标准）；独立审查接受。既有温控／氧梯度证据接入，但不等于该构造的物理实现或普遍根基完成；重叠继承不累加。
C30.scope_en: Earlier studies, including native unfolding (42 theorems / 64 new audits and its independent review), retain their scopes. This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added.

F22.title_zh: 关系恢复、组合唯一性与接口重建
F22.title_en: Relation recovery, composition uniqueness and reconstructed interfaces
F22.claim_zh: 继承校准、结构对手、组合唯一性及实际展开的接合／替换、分支继续与同规律错误反例；另增空历史探针、局部单位唯一性与关系同构下保持、完整接续充要条件和整个状态接口恢复。容量及内部序列丢失反例保留。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。
F22.claim_en: Retains calibration, structural rivals, compositional uniqueness and native unfolding’s joining/substitution, branch-continuation distinctions and same-law error cases. Adds empty-history probes, unique units and transport, an exact completion criterion and state-interface recovery, retaining capacity and internal-word-loss counters. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise.
F22.scope_zh: 实际展开42项定理／64项新审计与该研究继承248项审计保持原范围；本轮23＋31项新定理，另74项继承审计，共128项：105空、23仅propext。新54项中43空、11仅propext，无自定公理。数学恢复不等于物理取得或唯一基础。 新增14项定理／18项空依赖审计，另192项继承依赖不变（150空、42标准）；独立审查接受。既有温控／氧梯度证据接入，但不等于该构造的物理实现或普遍根基完成；重叠继承不累加。
F22.scope_en: Native unfolding retains its 42 theorems / 64 new and 248 inherited audits. This study adds 23+31 theorems with 74 inherited audits: 128 total, 105 empty and 23 propext only; new 54 comprise 43 empty and 11 propext only. No custom axioms. Recovery is not acquisition or unique grounding. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added.

The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness.

C30.scope_en: Earlier studies, including native unfolding (42 theorems / 64 new audits and its independent review), retain their scopes. This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed.
